title: Five markets compared
summary: How forex, ordinary stocks, penny stocks, commodities and futures differ in what you hold, trading hours, costs, leverage and margin, why one-line labels about a market mislead, and how to choose which market to study first.
practicalResult: Work through every row of the market comparison screen, then write a one-page note on which market you will study first, why, and what you will check about it before practising.
